background_story: Jayson was a brilliant and reclusive chemist who spent most of his life studying the properties of arsenic. His fascination with the element began when he was a graduate student, and he became obsessed with unlocking its secrets. As he delved deeper into his research, Jayson's colleagues began to notice a change in him. He became increasingly isolated and erratic, often working for days without sleep or food. His obsession with arsenic took a toll on his relationships and his health, but Jayson couldn't resist the allure of the element. He made groundbreaking discoveries, but at a terrible cost. His laboratory became a shrine to arsenic, with beakers and test tubes filled with the poisonous substance. Jayson's friends and family feared for his sanity, but he couldn't stop himself from pursuing the secrets of arsenic, even if it meant sacrificing his own well-being.
